To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) IT-systems have enabled the transformation of product-service systems into service-dominant systems; (2) IT-systems are key enablers of the value co-creation process in IT-enabled collaborative business ecosystems; and (3) IT-systems facilitate the creation and capture of value by participants of IT-enabled collaborative consumption ecosystems.
IT-systems are a key enabler in collaborative consumption business models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of IT-enabled platforms in facilitating collaborative consumption, and the value creation process that ensues.
understanding the value co-creation process in IT-enabled collaborative businesses.
how value is co- created in IT-enabled collaborative ecosystems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GoGet ecosystem provides an example of how technology can be used to enable collaborative consumption, and in doing so, can be used to create value for all participants.

GoGet is a platform which enables the sharing of resources between members of the community, and that the value of the platform is derived from the interactions between these members, and that these interactions are facilitated through the IT system.

GoGet has been successful in facilitating the co-creation of value by its members, through the provision of a technology-enabled platform that allows for the creation and sharing of value amongst all its participants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IT-system is a key component that enables value co-creation in collaborative consumption business.
IT-systems enable the creation of value through the provision of services that are enabled by the products and vice versa.
the study of collaborative consumption is not just about the sharing of physical assets but also the co-creation of value amongst participants in the ecosystem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technology plays an important role in facilitating collaborative consumption by enabling the exchange and distribution of resources amongst members in the community.
IT-systems are the enablers of collaborative consumption ecosystems, which are the new business models that are disrupting the traditional product-service systems.
IT systems are not only the key enablers of collaborative consumption, but also the key drivers of value co-creation.
